news.title: Ryan Giggs urged 'outstanding' England World Cup star to join Man Utd
news.lede: Manchester United legend Ryan Giggs (Picture: Getty) Ryan Giggs ‘tried to persuade’ England World Cup star Elliot Anderson to join Manchester United before his £116m move to Manchester City. Anderson signed a five-year deal at the Etihad Stadium last month after Man City briefly made him the most expensive British player in history. Manchester United were interested in beating their local rivals to a deal but pulled out of the race once Nottingham Forest’s demands went above £100m. Anderson became arguably Forest’s most important player following his £35m move from Newcastle United, helping the club finish seventh in the Premier League and qualify for Europe.

news.title: Gianni Infantino: UEFA signs joint letter slamming 'deception' at top of FIFA as World Cup stake sale fallout continues
news.lede: UEFA, CONMEBOL and AFC have hit out at "deception" and a "fundamental breach of trust" around Gianni Infantino's botched World Cup stake sale plans to further raise the pressure on the under-fire FIFA president. The three continental associations each signed a new open letter to the "football family" on Monday, without naming Infantino specifically but referring to a leader who "abandoned their duty" by breaking trust "through deception". In the three-page document they again criticised the president's World Cup sale plans and rejected FIFA's claim that they had been a "mistake", adding: "There remains no recognition that attempting to sell an interest in the FIFA World Cup was a profound failure of judgment - not just a procedural misstep, but a fundamental breach of trust with the very institutions FIFA exists to serve."

news.title: Nike Honours Mbappé’s World Cup Legacy With New Signature Mercurial Superfly 11
news.lede: When you're the Golden Boot winner at back-to-back World Cups and the all-time leading goalscorer in tournament history, a standard player edition just isn't going to cut it. So it's only right that Nike has celebrated Kylian Mbappé’s incredible legacy with a brand new signature Mercurial Superfly 11. And yes, as you'd probably expect, it's dripping in gold. Arriving in a striking "Mtlc Gold/Green Glow/White" colourway, Mbappé's latest signature boot takes direct inspiration from the Frenchman's accomplishments on football’s biggest stage.

news.title: World football turns on Infantino as UEFA, AFC and CONCACAF demand review
news.lede: The battle over FIFA's controversial plan to sell a stake linked to the commercial value of the World Cup has escalated into a major governance crisis. UEFA, the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) and Concacaf have jointly accused FIFA leadership of breaking the trust of the football community and called for an independent review of the entire episode.The three confederations issued a strongly worded open letter on Monday, taking aim at the way FIFA president Gianni Infantino and his administration handled the proposal. They rejected FIFA's explanation that the controversy was simply a communication failure and argued that the episode reflected a much deeper problem with how decisions are being made at the top of world football. news.lede: Infantino has been the butt of scathing criticism ever since launching, and then withdrawing within days, a plan to bring in private investment into FIFA competitions, including the World Cups. news.title: Austria’s football story: From Vienna’s gardens to the world stage
news.lede: Football has blossomed in the Alpine nation since being introduced by a gardener in the 19th century, producing a colourful array of teams, talent and even an NFL kicker. More than 130 years ago, English gardener James Black moved to Vienna to tend to the grounds of Baron Rothschild. The tales of football that he shared with colleagues laid the local seeds for the beautiful game, and in 1894 he was a founding member of First Vienna, the nation’s pioneering football club. From there, the sport grew quickly, with Vienna’s famous coffee house culture providing fertile ground for intellectuals and players alike to sit and discuss revolutionary footballing ideas.

news.title: Gianni Infantino: Fifa accused of breaking trust 'through deception'
news.lede: FIFA president Gianni Infantino was first elected in 2016. Fifa and its president Gianni Infantino have been accused of breaking trust "through deception" in an open letter issued by Uefa, Concacaf and the Asian Football Confederation. The letter, signed by the presidents and general secretaries, said recent controversy over the Fifa Forward Enterprise (FFE) proposal was fundamentally about "the integrity of the game, and the integrity of those elected to lead it". FFE would have meant a new company being created to manage commercial and ticketing rights of all Fifa competitions, including the World Cups, with 21% sold off to a private investment company.
